metadata.module_name: Mundane Astrology - World Events & Collective Cycles
metadata.purpose: Analyze nations, world events, political cycles, collective movements
metadata.scope: Global, national, and collective astrological patterns

core_principles.mundane_definition: Astrology of the world, nations, and collective humanity
core_principles.differs_from_natal: Focus on groups, nations, events rather than individuals
chart_types: Outer planet cycle charts (conjunctions, squares, oppositions)
core_principles.interpretation_approach: Outer planets = generational themes; faster planets = current events

pluto_cycles.meaning: Death-rebirth of civilizations; power transformation; collective shadow

Pluto_in_Cancer.themes: WWI & WWII, nationalism, home & family crisis, rise of totalitarianism
Pluto_in_Cancer.transformation: End of old empires; birth of modern nation-states

Pluto_in_Leo.themes: WWII, nuclear power, rise of entertainment, creative destruction
Pluto_in_Leo.transformation: Atomic age; television; celebrity culture; Cold War begins

Pluto_in_Virgo.themes: Health crisis (polio vaccine), work transformation, technology, service
Pluto_in_Virgo.transformation: Space race; computers; health revolution; Vietnam

Pluto_in_Libra.themes: Relationship transformation, divorce rates, diplomacy, art movements
Pluto_in_Libra.transformation: Women's liberation; disco; punk; détente and Cold War shifts

Pluto_in_Scorpio.themes: AIDS crisis, sexual revolution deepens, death awareness, power
Pluto_in_Scorpio.transformation: Berlin Wall falls; Soviet collapse; taboo topics emerge

Pluto_in_Sagittarius.transformation: Internet explosion; 9/11; religious extremism; global economy

Pluto_in_Capricorn.themes: Authority crisis, economic collapse & rebuild, government transformation
Pluto_in_Capricorn.transformation: 2008 crash; rise of authoritarianism; system breakdown; COVID-19

Pluto_in_Aquarius.themes: Technology transformation, AI, collective power, humanitarian crisis
Pluto_in_Aquarius.prediction: Decentralization, technological revolution, new power structures

neptune_cycles.meaning: Collective dreams, spirituality, illusions, art movements, dissolution

Neptune_in_Scorpio.themes: Sexual revolution, psychedelics, occult interest, death awareness

Neptune_in_Sagittarius.themes: New Age spirituality, travel illusions, religious movements, cults

Neptune_in_Capricorn.themes: Authority illusions, corporate spirituality, government deception

Neptune_in_Aquarius.themes: Internet illusions, collective dreams, humanitarian ideals, technology spirituality

Neptune_in_Pisces.themes: Compassion awakening, addiction crisis, spiritual dissolution, boundary loss
Neptune_in_Pisces.current: Opioid epidemic, fake news, compassion fatigue, spiritual renaissance

Neptune_in_Aries.themes: Spiritual warrior, new spiritual identity, pioneering consciousness

uranus_cycles.meaning: Revolution, technology, liberation, sudden change, innovation

Uranus_in_Aquarius.themes: Internet revolution, humanitarian technology, dot-com bubble

Uranus_in_Pisces.themes: Spiritual awakening technology, social media compassion, boundary dissolution

Uranus_in_Aries.themes: Arab Spring, individual liberation, warrior awakening, identity revolution

Uranus_in_Taurus.themes: Financial revolution, cryptocurrency, earth changes, resource innovation
Uranus_in_Taurus.current: Crypto boom, climate crisis, resource scarcity, value shifts

Uranus_in_Gemini.themes: Communication revolution, AI explosion, information liberation, mental breakthroughs

saturn_jupiter_cycles.meaning: Major sociopolitical shifts; old order meets new expansion

great_mutation_theory.definition: Saturn-Jupiter conjunctions in same element for ~200 years, then 'mutate' to new element

earth_era.themes: Materialism, industry, capitalism, physical reality focus

air_era.themes: Information age, ideas, communication, social networks, AI, collective mind
air_era.prediction: Shift from physical wealth to informational wealth; decentralization

2000_conjunction.themes: Dot-com bubble burst; material security vs technology

2020_conjunction.themes: COVID-19 shift; technology revolution; new social order; information age begins
2020_conjunction.significance: First air conjunction in 200 years - paradigm shift

uranus_pluto_cycles.meaning: Revolutionary transformation; generational upheaval; creative destruction

conjunction_1960s.themes: 60s revolution, civil rights, sexual revolution, Vietnam protests, counterculture
conjunction_1960s.generation: Born with this aspect = revolutionary transformation agents

square_2012_2015.signs: Uranus in Aries square Pluto in Capricorn
square_2012_2015.themes: Arab Spring, Occupy, system breakdown, revolutionary vs authority
square_2012_2015.manifestation: Challenge to old power structures; youth vs establishment

neptune_pluto_cycles.meaning: Extremely slow; dissolution meets transformation; spiritual-material merge
neptune_pluto_cycles.current_aspect: Sextile (60°) throughout late 20th and early 21st century - supportive spiritual transformation

national_charts.definition: Chart for founding moment of nation (declaration, constitution signing, etc.)

united_states_chart.time: Various times debated; ~5:10 PM LMT Philadelphia common
united_states_chart.moon: Aquarius or Gemini (depending on time) - humanitarian ideals or communication

key_features.Sun_square_Saturn: Authority issues; government restrictions vs freedom
key_features.Mars_square_Neptune: Idealistic action; confusion in military; oil/gas issues
key_features.Pluto_return_2022: First-ever Pluto return at ~248 years; transformation of power

transits_to_us_chart.Pluto_return_2022_2024: Death-rebirth of nation; power transformation; shadow reckoning
transits_to_us_chart.Uranus_return_2027_2028: Revolutionary shifts every 84 years; awakening, liberation

other_nations.method: Use founding date/time (independence, constitution, revolution success)

aries_ingress.definition: Chart for Sun entering Aries (Spring Equinox) in capital city
aries_ingress.duration: Valid for entire year (some say entire quarter)

interpretation.ascendant: How nation presents itself this year

new_moon.interpretation: House of New Moon shows area of new focus

full_moon.interpretation: Opposition axis shows tension between two areas

eclipse_lunations.solar_eclipse: Super New Moon; major new beginnings; 6-month to 1-year effects
eclipse_lunations.lunar_eclipse: Super Full Moon; major culminations; revelations; endings

saros_cycle.meaning: Similar eclipses repeat with similar themes
saros_cycle.use: Look back 18-19 years for echo of current eclipse themes

eclipse_sensitive_points.definition: Degrees where eclipses fall become sensitive for ~2-3 years
eclipse_sensitive_points.activation: Transiting planets to eclipse degrees trigger eclipse themes
eclipse_sensitive_points.national_impact: If eclipse falls on national chart planet/angle, major event likely

1st_house.nation: The people, national identity, how nation presents itself

2nd_house.nation: National wealth, treasury, banks, GDP, material resources

4th_house.nation: Land, agriculture, real estate, opposition party, homeland security, end of matters

5th_house.nation: Entertainment, sports, children, birth rate, speculation, gambling

6th_house.nation: Workers, labor unions, public health, military (enlisted), civil service

7th_house.nation: Foreign relations, treaties, allies, open enemies, war, diplomacy

8th_house.nation: Death rate, debt, taxes, insurance, shared resources, transformation, crises

9th_house.nation: Legal system, courts, religion, higher education, foreign travel, philosophy

10th_house.nation: Government, president/prime minister, executive, reputation, authority

11th_house.nation: Legislature, congress, parliament, hopes of nation, technology, groups

12th_house.nation: Prisons, hospitals, monasteries, secret enemies, espionage, hidden matters, undoing

planetary_rulers_in_mundane.Sun: Leader, president, monarch, government, national vitality
planetary_rulers_in_mundane.Moon: The people, public opinion, women, agriculture, tides, emotion
planetary_rulers_in_mundane.Mercury: Media, communication, trade, youth, transportation, technology
planetary_rulers_in_mundane.Venus: Arts, diplomacy, women's issues, peace, beauty, social harmony
planetary_rulers_in_mundane.Mars: Military, police, war, violence, accidents, surgery, conflict
planetary_rulers_in_mundane.Jupiter: Law, religion, expansion, optimism, prosperity, judges, philosophy
planetary_rulers_in_mundane.Saturn: Restrictions, government structure, elderly, agriculture, real estate, discipline
planetary_rulers_in_mundane.Uranus: Revolution, sudden change, technology, innovation, aviation, electricity
planetary_rulers_in_mundane.Neptune: Oil, gas, chemicals, film, spirituality, deception, scandals, dissolution
planetary_rulers_in_mundane.Pluto: Transformation, nuclear power, death rate, regeneration, underground, crime

step_1_slow_planets.action: Identify current outer planet positions and aspects
step_1_slow_planets.focus: Pluto, Neptune, Uranus positions by sign and major aspects

step_2_medium_planets.focus: Where are they by sign and house in national chart?

step_3_ingress_analysis.action: Cast Aries Ingress for capital city
step_3_ingress_analysis.focus: Angular planets, aspects to national chart

step_4_eclipse_analysis.action: Note eclipse degrees and which national chart points they activate
step_4_eclipse_analysis.focus: House axis of eclipses in national chart

step_5_lunations.action: Track New/Full Moons in national chart
step_5_lunations.focus: Which houses and planets activated monthly

step_6_event_charts.action: When major event occurs, cast chart for moment
step_6_event_charts.focus: Chart shows nature and outcome of event

chart_features.Saturn_opposition_Pluto: Exact - authority vs transformation; structure vs destruction
chart_features.Mars_in_Capricorn: Action in authority structures; government/military activation
chart_features.North_Node_in_Gemini: Communication, media, information as destiny point

911_attacks.transit_to_us_chart: Saturn opposed US Sun (identity crisis); Pluto squared US Saturn (authority transformation)

astrological_signature.Pluto_in_Capricorn_beginning: Transformation of authority and financial systems

astrological_signature.Jupiter_conjunct_Pluto_Capricorn: Multiple times in 2020 - expansion of transformation

covid_19_pandemic.interpretation: Perfect storm of transformation aspects; old world dying, new world being born

mundane_ethics.multiple_outcomes: Same aspect can manifest many ways
mundane_ethics.historical_context: Study past cycles for insight, not prediction
